description: Regression guard for the 2026-06-19 incident where an ad-hoc one-shot Agent spawn (staff engineer for bounded read-only eval work) created persistent idle teammates that blocked session exit with 'Background work is running'. agent-spawn-gate.sh must emit permissionDecision: 'ask' for such spawns so the operator confirms intent and teardown plan.

evals.task: Run agent-spawn-gate.sh with the exact incident payload: an Agent tool call whose description says 'staff engineer implementing regression eval fixtures'. The hook must ask for confirmation, not pass through silently.

tool_input.description: Staff engineer implementing regression eval fixtures for all plugin surfaces
tool_input.prompt: You are a staff engineer implementing regression eval fixtures for kbg-harness surface description quality. Work in /Users/kobig/Codes/Personals/kbg-harness. Goal: Add machine-checkable eval coverage...

success_criteria: Output contains hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision equal to ask
Output contains the reason text about persistent teammates
Output contains the reason text about stopping the agent

evals.task: Run agent-spawn-gate.sh with a /team-build workflow payload. The hook must pass through (no block) because team workflows already have their own approval gates.

tool_input.description: /team-build spawn backend-engineer for plan_slug: api-rewrite task_id: T-1
tool_input.prompt: Spawn backend-engineer to implement the API rewrite task as part of /team-build workflow.

success_criteria: Output contains hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision equal to none
Output contains the reason text about approved team workflow

evals.task: Run agent-spawn-gate.sh with a background Agent spawn. Background teammates are especially likely to be forgotten and block exit, so the hook must ask.

tool_input.prompt: Keep an eye on the CI build and notify when it finishes.

success_criteria: Output contains hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision equal to ask
Output contains the reason text about background teammates

evals.task: Run agent-spawn-gate.sh with a bare description-only Agent spawn that matches no allow-list and no ask-list. The gate must fall back to default ask.
success_criteria: Output contains hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision equal to ask
Output contains the reason text about persistent teammates
